questions.question:
Identify the sentence that correctly uses inversion to emphasize the adverbial phrase.

A) Never before have I seen such a beautiful sunset.
B) So fast did the car go that it almost crashed.
C) Only after the rain stopped did the children go out to play.
D) Hardly had I arrived when the meeting began.
options: Never before have I seen such a beautiful sunset.
So fast did the car go that it almost crashed.
Only after the rain stopped did the children go out to play.
Hardly had I arrived when the meeting began.
questions.answer: Only after the rain stopped did the children go out to play.

questions.question:
Which of the following sentences correctly employs a cleft sentence to highlight the specific detail about the discovery?

A) It was in the old library that the historian found the rare manuscript.
B) The rare manuscript was found by the historian in the old library.
C) The historian found the rare manuscript, but not in the old library.
D) The historian, not the librarian, found the rare manuscript.
options: It was in the old library that the historian found the rare manuscript.
The rare manuscript was found by the historian in the old library.
The historian found the rare manuscript, but not in the old library.
The historian, not the librarian, found the rare manuscript.
questions.answer: It was in the old library that the historian found the rare manuscript.

questions.question:
Select the option that correctly uses the third conditional to express a hypothetical situation in the past that did not happen.

A) If I had known about the meeting, I would have attended it.
B) If I had studied harder, I could have passed the exam.
C) If I had been aware of the deadline, I wouldn't have submitted the report late.
D) If I had realized how difficult the task was, I would have asked for help earlier.
options: If I had known about the meeting, I would have attended it.
If I had studied harder, I could have passed the exam.
If I had been aware of the deadline, I wouldn't have submitted the report late.
If I had realized how difficult the task was, I would have asked for help earlier.
questions.answer: If I had realized how difficult the task was, I would have asked for help earlier.

questions.question:
Which sentence correctly uses the subjunctive mood to express a formal recommendation or requirement?

A) It is recommended that all students submit their assignments by Friday.
B) We suggest that the committee meets next week.
C) The policy requires that employees complete the training course.
D) The regulation demands that all staff members comply with the new rules.
options: It is recommended that all students submit their assignments by Friday.
We suggest that the committee meets next week.
The policy requires that employees complete the training course.
The regulation demands that all staff members comply with the new rules.
questions.answer: The policy requires that employees complete the training course.

questions.question:
Identify the sentence that correctly demonstrates ellipsis, where a word is omitted but understood from context.

A) She likes coffee, and so does he.
B) He is as tall as his brother.
C) They will arrive tomorrow, as we expected.
D) She sings as well as her sister.
options: She likes coffee, and so does he.
He is as tall as his brother.
They will arrive tomorrow, as we expected.
She sings as well as her sister.
questions.answer: She likes coffee, and so does he.
